_comment: Step-free access at the 15 stations in data/rail_stations.json, from each station's National Rail page: its step-free category and whether the platforms are level with or above the main entrance, in National Rail's words. Shown at the top of a station's board (app.js). Checked by hand, 6 November 2026, at the maintainer's request; a lift out of order or other temporary notice is not kept here, since the station page carries it.

categories.A: There is step-free access to all platforms.
categories.B1: There is step-free access to all platforms, which may be by long or steep ramps or along streets.
categories.B2: There is some step-free access to all platforms.
categories.B3: There is some step-free access to platforms, but this may be in one direction only.
categories.C: There is no step-free access to platforms.

DUR.platforms: The platforms are above the level of the main entrance.

WWO.platforms: The platforms are level with the main entrance.

WRH.platforms: The platforms are level with the main entrance.
